config.description: Configuration object for pwgen wrapper settings. Note: This schema is abstracted because pwgen has no native config file; this represents the logical parameters passed to the binary.

config.pw_length.description: The length of the generated passwords. Corresponds to the [pw_length] argument.

config.num_passwords.description: The number of passwords to generate. Corresponds to the [num_pw] argument or -N option.

config.include_numerals.description: Include at least one number in the password. Corresponds to -n/--numerals.

config.include_capitals.description: Include at least one capital letter. Corresponds to -c/--capitalize.

config.include_symbols.description: Include at least one special character. Corresponds to -y/--symbols.

config.secure_mode.description: Generate completely random, hard-to-memorize passwords. Corresponds to -s/--secure.

config.remove_ambiguous.description: Don't use characters that could be confused (e.g., l/1, 0/O). Corresponds to -B/--ambiguous.

config.excluded_chars.description: Specific characters to exclude from passwords. Corresponds to -r/--remove-chars. Items are individual characters.

config.one_per_line.description: Print generated passwords one per line. Corresponds to -1.
